## GetBill

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/GetBill`

What the installation cost in a month, as its cloud's bill says: by day and service, what the month is forecast to end at, and its budget. As the control plane last read the bill - a few times a day (internal/controlplane/domain/bill) - never the cloud itself, where every question to its billing is billed.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `month` | `Timestamp` | The month, as any instant in it (UTC's); unset is the month in progress. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `month` | `Timestamp` | The month's first instant, UTC. |
| `readAt` | `Timestamp` | When the bill was last read; unset where it never was - no scope (bill_scope), or a cloud that sends none - and then nothing below is known. |
| `currency` | string | ISO 4217; every amount here is in millionths of it. |
| `totalMicros` | string (int64) | The month so far, every day and service. |
| `forecastMicros` | string or null (int64) | What the month is forecast to end at; unset where the cloud has no forecast yet. |
| `budgetLimitMicros` | string or null (int64) | The installation's budget and what the cloud counts against it; unset where it has none. |
| `budgetActualMicros` | string or null (int64) |  |
| `budgetForecastMicros` | string or null (int64) |  |
| `days` | list of [BillDay](/reference/api/types/#billday) | Oldest first. |

## GetCosts

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/GetCosts`

A month of the bill shared out to the workspaces that caused it: the runners' by what each workspace held of them, the volumes' bucket by what its volumes kept. What nobody caused is said apart and never spread: the runners' capacity nobody held, the bucket's bytes no workspace keeps, and the platform's own cost by service (internal/controlplane/domain/finops).

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `month` | `Timestamp` | The month, as any instant in it (UTC's); unset is the month in progress. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `month` | `Timestamp` | The month's first instant, UTC. |
| `currency` | string | ISO 4217; every amount here is in millionths of it. |
| `workspaces` | list of [WorkspaceCost](/reference/api/types/#workspacecost) | Costliest first. |
| `idleMicros` | string (int64) | What the runners cost that no workspace held. |
| `unstoredMicros` | string (int64) | What the volumes' bucket cost for bytes no workspace keeps: the images, what nothing references any more. |
| `platform` | list of [ServiceCost](/reference/api/types/#servicecost) | Every other cost - the control plane, the proxy, keys, logs - by service, costliest first. |

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/GetStorageUsage`

What the store holds, by what each object is for: every volume's objects and the layers its commits name, with the workspace, image or extension release it is. As the storage-gc job last read it - daily, or when an admin runs it - never the bucket itself.

| `other` | [StorageTally](/reference/api/types/#storagetally) | Everything outside volumes/ and layers/: the control plane's election records. |
| `measuredAt` | `Timestamp` |  |

## ListAuditLog

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/ListAuditLog`

Read the audit log, newest first. There is no RPC that writes one: an entry is written by the operation it records, so a log an API could add to would be one an API could forge.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `page` | [PageRequest](/reference/api/types/#pagerequest) |  |
| `actorId` | string | Each filter is optional and they are combined with AND; an empty request is the whole log, newest first. |
| `action` | string |  |
| `resourceType` | string |  |
| `since` | `Timestamp` | since bounds the listing at the older end; an audit log is read forward from an incident, and the whole of one is not what a page wants. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `entries` | list of [AuditEntry](/reference/api/types/#auditentry) |  |
| `page` | [PageResponse](/reference/api/types/#pageresponse) |  |
| `actions` | list of string | actions and resource_types are every value this installation can record, so a reader building a filter does not have to know them. They come from the code rather than from a DISTINCT over the log: the log is the one table that only grows, and a vocabulary that is empty until something happens is a filter that is empty when it matters. |
| `resourceTypes` | list of string |  |
| `totalCapped` | boolean | total_capped says page.total_count is where counting stopped, not the count: the log is counted up to a bound, since counting all of it is reading all of it on every page. |

## PublishVSCodeServers

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/PublishVSCodeServers`

Publish the servers of the newest stable VS Code releases, or of the commits named, as a new release. Answers once the publish has begun - it downloads a gigabyte - and GetVSCodeServers says how it goes.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `newest` | integer (int32) | The newest stable releases to carry: 2 is the current one and the one before it. |
| `commits` | list of string | Commits to carry besides, each the second line of `code --version`. |

**Response**

No fields: `{}`.

## RekeyVolume

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/RekeyVolume`

Re-key a workspace's disk: copy it whole under a key of its own, point the workspace at the copy, and delete the disk - which shreds the key assumed taken and every snapshot of the disk, since those are what that key opens. The workspace must be stopped or quarantined. Refused for a disk something descends from. Audited.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workspaceId` | string |  |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `targetVolumeId` | string |  |

## RemoveStoredVolume

`POST /spin.v1.AdminService/RemoveStoredVolume`

Remove an image, an extension release, an unclaimed volume or an orphan from the store: its row, then its volume, whose key is shredded; storage-gc collects its layers on its next run. Refused for one that is kept (StoredVolume.kept_because), one placed on a host, and a workspace's disk. Audited.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `volumeId` | string |  |

**Response**

No fields: `{}`.
